fixes.explanation: True! Verse 42 says Joshua captured all these kings and their land "…in one campaign." Then verse 43 says he "returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal." One campaign, then straight home to camp. That's the person who finishes the whole errand list in one trip. You know that person, and you know you are not that person. The rest of us come home missing the ONE thing.

problems.problem: Papa describes himself running errands and coming home, putting him in a modern scenario outside his bakery. He can describe such scenarios as things people do, not as his own activities.
